title: Classical cohomology of comparison inverse image
statement:
theorem classicalDerivedImage (X : Scheme.{u}) (Λ : Type (u + 1))
    [CommRing Λ] [TopologicalSpace Λ] [DiscreteTopology Λ]
    (_hunit : ∀ L : DerivedCategory.Plus
      (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)),
      IsIso ((comparisonAdjunction (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) X).derivedPlus.unit.app L)) :
    ∀ L : DerivedCategory.Plus
      (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)),
      ClassicalPlus X Λ
        ((comparisonUpperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) X).mapDerivedCategoryPlus.obj L)

source.place: Proof paragraph (1): exact inverse image commutes with cohomology, which is classical.

proof.text: Apply the module-valued clause of proEtaleClassicalSheaves to the cohomology sheaf of the source. Exact inverse image commutes with bounded-below derived homology. Naturality of continuityMap transports classicality along this isomorphism. The definition uses standard-model cohomology; identify it with small-model cohomology by cancelling the localization functor in their common factorization through complex homology and the ShrinkHoms equivalence.

proof_origin.place: Four proof paragraphs, with explicit derived-category tools from Stacks 015F, 05TC, 08J5, 0A8D, 05RS and 05QB; no change to the unit route.
